records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the quarter ended December 30, 2023, 37% of revenue was recognized at the point in time control transferred to the customer.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The twelve-month backlog increased in the first quarter of 2024 compared with the first quarter of 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Partially offsetting these increases was a decline in Industrial's twelve-month backlog due to lower orders across our industrial automation programs.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Gross margin increased in the first quarter of 2024 compared to the first quarter of 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net cash provided by operating activities in the first quarter of 2024 increased compared to the first quarter of 2023.
